title: Lavender vs Sage Green Taffeta Anarkali: Which to Choose?
excerpt: Lavender or sage green taffeta Anarkali? Compare skin tone, occasion, jewellery and photos to pick the right gota work Anarkali for your event.
body:
Choose the lavender taffeta Anarkali if you want a soft, dreamy look for a day wedding, a mehendi or a baby shower, and the sage green taffeta Anarkali if you want a slightly richer, more modern look for an evening reception, Christmas dinner or Eid. Both have gota work and a sheer dupatta, so the choice comes down to your skin undertone, the event and the jewellery you already own.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Both Anarkalis are stitched in our own Jaipur unit.*

**Quick answer**

- Lavender: soft and romantic, best for day events and cool or neutral undertones
- Sage green: earthy and elegant, best for evenings and warm or olive undertones
- Lavender comes with an organza dupatta; sage green comes with a sequin organza dupatta
- Silver and pearls suit lavender; gold and kundan suit sage green
- Both are taffeta silk with gota work, so the shape and flare are similar

## What is the main difference between them?

Both Anarkalis share the same base: taffeta silk with gota work. Taffeta is crisp and holds its shape, so both give you a full, graceful flare. The real differences are colour and dupatta.

The [lavender taffeta silk Anarkali with organza dupatta](/products/lavender-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-organza-dupatta/) has a soft, cool tone that feels light and romantic. Its organza dupatta is sheer and airy.

The [sage green taffeta silk Anarkali with sequin organza dupatta](/products/sage-green-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-sequin-organza-dupatta/) is a muted, grey-tinted green that feels calm and grown-up. The sequin organza dupatta adds a little more sparkle, which suits evening events.

## How do they compare side by side?

| Factor | Lavender | Sage green |
|---|---|---|
| Mood | Soft, dreamy, romantic | Earthy, calm, elegant |
| Best skin undertone | Cool or neutral | Warm, olive or neutral |
| Best time of day | Daytime and early evening | Evening and indoor events |
| Dupatta | Organza | Sequin organza |
| Jewellery | Silver, pearls, rose gold | Gold, kundan, emerald stones |
| Best events | Day wedding, mehendi, baby shower | Reception, Christmas dinner, Eid |

## Which colour suits my skin tone?

A simple test: look at the veins on your inner wrist in daylight. If they look more blue or purple, you likely have a cool undertone. If they look more green, you likely have a warm undertone. If you cannot tell, you are probably neutral, and both colours will work.

Cool undertones often glow in lavender, because the cool pinkish-purple echoes the skin. Warm and olive undertones often look radiant in sage green, because the earthy green balances golden skin. Deeper skin tones look stunning in both, especially with gold jewellery.

These are only guides. If you love a colour, wear it with confidence.

## Which one is better for my event?

### Choose lavender for

A daytime wedding, a mehendi in a garden, a baby shower, a spring engagement, or any event where you want to look soft and fresh. Lavender also photographs beautifully in natural light.

### Choose sage green for

An evening reception, a Christmas dinner, an Eid dawat, a winter wedding or a formal party. The sequin organza dupatta catches indoor lights and looks festive at night.

### Consider both if

You have a multi-day wedding. Wear lavender for the day functions and sage green for the evening ones. They sit well together in a capsule, and you could even swap dupattas for a fresh look. Our guide on [how to choose an Anarkali for a wedding](/blog/how-to-choose-an-anarkali-for-a-wedding/) explains how to match silhouette to function.

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Taffeta silk has a gentle rustle and a soft sheen that shifts as you move. Lavender taffeta looks almost pearly under daylight, while sage green taffeta takes on a silvery tone under warm evening lights. Gota on both catches light without looking flashy.

## What about the dupatta: organza or sequin organza?

Organza is sheer, crisp and light. A plain organza dupatta, like the one with the lavender set, feels soft and elegant and suits day events. A sequin organza dupatta, like the one with the sage green set, adds sparkle and is ideal for night.

Our guide to [georgette vs chiffon vs organza](/blog/georgette-vs-chiffon-vs-organza/) explains how each fabric drapes and how to care for it.

## Are there other shades to consider?

If neither feels quite right, the [purple bandhani chiffon Anarkali](/products/purple-bandhani-chiffon-anarkali-suit-set/) is a deeper, more colourful option with a softer drape. It suits mehendi and sangeet nights.

Browse all our [Anarkali suits](/anarkali-suits-online-usa-uk/) to compare.

## How do I order the right fit?

Both Anarkalis can be stitched to your measurements at no extra cost. Share your bust, waist, hip and height, and we will send photos of your piece being made. Made-to-measure takes 5–7 working days, plus about 5–10 business days for delivery, so order 3–4 weeks ahead. Shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia is free and duties-paid.

## Our pick for you

For day events and cool undertones, choose the [lavender taffeta Anarkali](/products/lavender-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-organza-dupatta/).

For evenings and warm undertones, choose the [sage green taffeta Anarkali](/products/sage-green-taffeta-silk-gota-work-anarkali-suit-set-with-sequin-organza-dupatta/). A small etiquette note: if the bride has chosen a pastel palette, check with the family before wearing a very similar shade.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is lavender or sage green better for a wedding guest?**
Lavender suits day weddings and mehendi; sage green suits evening receptions. Both are elegant and safe choices for guests.

**What jewellery goes with a lavender Anarkali?**
Silver, pearls and rose gold look lovely with lavender. For a richer look, try polki or soft gold.

**Does sage green suit dusky skin?**
Yes. Sage green looks beautiful on deeper skin tones, especially with gold or kundan jewellery.

**How do I care for a taffeta silk Anarkali?**
Dry clean only. Store it folded in a cotton bag with the gota work turned inwards, and steam lightly to remove creases.
